core.title: 4-1/2 x 8 Solid Brass Parliament Hinge, Deltana DSPA4580

text.description_html:
Deltana DSPA4580, 4-1/2" x 8" Parliament Hinge Pair

4-1/2" by 8" Residential Parliament Hinge. 0.238" thick. Tooled for a tight knuckle action. A parliament hinge is a butt hinge where the knuckle protrudes from the door so that the door when fully opened stands away from the wall. Designed for doors that need to swing 180° and clear a projection such as a decorative molding around the door frame. It is often used on windows and shutters because this type of hinge allow them to swing past deep trim work. A solid brass hinge, it is available in 3 finishes.

Package includes a set of two hinges and wood screws.

Specifications:

  • Height: 4-1/2"
  • Width: 8"
  • Corners: square
  • Thickness (gauge): 0.238"
  • Wood Screws: #12 x 1-1/4""
  • Material: Solid Brass
  • Full Mortise
  • Extruded

Sold in Pairs (2 Hinges)
